scope: Named baseline capability coverage, not every skill or agent in existence
authorship: Original additions; no Superpowers source content imported

comparison.reason: Clarify the requested outcome, compare material choices and obtain the necessary design decision without copying another framework's dialogue.
Build bounded implementation steps with real dependencies, file context and acceptance checks in the existing planning lifecycle.
Observe the intended behavior failure, implement the approved change and preserve regression evidence through refactoring.
Execute the approved dependency-aware plan within configured scope, reporting blocked prerequisites and actual verification.
Coordinate permitted isolated tasks with explicit ownership and independent validation, without mandatory automatic delegation.
Use observed failure evidence and competing causal hypotheses before a bounded, testable repair.
Audit fresh evidence for the exact candidate and distinguish failed, blocked, stale and unexecuted checks from success.
Prepare a focused review request with the actual candidate, required behavior, evidence and unresolved risks.
Assess findings against code and requirements before accepting them, then route supported follow-up work explicitly.
Permit parallel work only for independent contexts with no conflicting writes and a clear integration owner.
Plan or perform only the authorized worktree operation, preserving dirty work and verifying repository and branch context.
Separate validated work from publication and cleanup decisions, with human-owned merge and explicit authorization.
Provide native canonical skill discovery and task selection rather than install another framework's mandatory bootstrap or precedence rules.
Author and evaluate an original canonical skill using repository metadata, portable procedures and positive/negative scenarios.
Diagnose this plugin's discovery, version and prerequisite failures; an uninstalled external framework needs no copied runtime diagnostics.

genericPurposes.reason: Edit approved technical prose for clear audience-appropriate language while retaining facts, attribution and uncertainty.
Draft professional content from approved facts without claiming unsupported results or publishing automatically.
Specify an accessible profile/banner composition without assuming an image-generation tool or requesting unapproved generation.
Inventory and propose a non-destructive workspace organization plan, preserving repository boundaries and existing work.
Deduplicate supported review findings and convert them into owner-reviewed follow-up proposals rather than automatic ticket creation.
Compose existing design-system and accessibility methods instead of duplicating a second UI review checklist.
Design and implement an approved accessible report using the target renderer; app-specific inline display transport remains outside the generic core.
Prepare audience-scoped summaries from approved evidence, distinguishing delivery activity from measured outcomes.
Review source-linked local knowledge with freshness and explicit promotion authority rather than ingest untrusted content as memory.
Track explicitly stated commitments with identity, owner confirmation, due windows and unresolved status.
Prepare decision-oriented meeting material from approved inputs without inventing conversations, commitments or attendee intent.
Normalize provider-neutral failure evidence and route a bounded investigation without embedding enterprise connector code.
Separate explicit contribution links from inferred associations, preserve source identities and record unresolved joins.
Require valid cohorts, units, denominators, baselines and shared-credit evidence before interpreting a measured outcome.
Produce source-supported drafts and a readiness assessment, not an installed measurement database or fabricated benefits.
Inspect canonical discovery and approved host prerequisites without silently replacing plugin caches, accounts or configuration.
